# ROADMAP: cornerstone 1 points at the content-sized rows epic

## Context

`ROADMAP.md` cornerstone 1 (content-sized rows, steward Ada) anchors to #9495 and calls the design "open in D#19645". On 2026-10-12 three things changed:
- the operator closed #9495 as superseded;
- D#19645 graduated, at body SHA-256 `5c5c9d62…`, with claude and gpt signals;
- the fresh epic #19658 now carries the accepted text-only PoC contract and sits on milestone v13.3.

The milestone description already names #19658.

## The Problem

The file every session starts from sends readers to a closed ticket, and to a Discussion that no longer holds open design.

## The Fix

In the cornerstone table, row 1's anchor becomes #19658. D#19645 stays linked as the design record, no longer as "open". In **How it runs**, the sentence "Cornerstones 1 and 2 take their shape from their Discussions; their epics gain leaves once those converge" changes to say that cornerstone 1's Discussion has graduated into #19658, while cornerstone 2's (D#19646) is still converging.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] Cornerstone 1's anchor is #19658, with D#19645 linked as its graduated design record.
- [x] **How it runs** states which grid Discussion has graduated and which is still converging, and nothing else in the file changes.

## Out of Scope

The header-menus row (#19643 and D#19646), which changes when D#19646 graduates. The release-cut row: #19637 is delivered, and its done signal is checked at the cut.
